name: Abigail (Abby) Aidoo
bio: Management accounting and entrepreneurship professional with experience in operations, business development and support for African entrepreneurs. UBC MBA graduate.

name: Terry Sunderland
bio: Professor of tropical forestry whose research connects forests, biodiversity, food security and livelihoods. His IUFRO award biography identifies the United Kingdom as his birthplace.

name: Adrian Bukenya
role: Senior Director · Mastercard Foundation Scholars Programs
bio: Global Scholars Program leader with experience in energy, infrastructure, finance and operations across Africa. His official biography confirms his Uganda country leadership role; it does not state his country of origin.
